notes: Caller for %EndringFraKlass against a bundled ;-delimited municipality change list (Klass cat 131). Only edit vs upstream: the live Klass API 'filename url' is read from ./input/changes.csv via an added innfil= param. Exercises the INPUT step, PROC SORT NODUPKEY, PROC SQL self-join, DATA UPDATE, and the PROC FORMAT CNTLIN recode-format build; a follow-up PROC PRINT applies the generated $omkode format. The bundle is self-contained: autoexec.sas writes the sample list (same rows as input/changes.csv) to the working directory, which the macro's FILENAME/INFILE then reads.
